description: This file contains unit tests for the TLS server handshaker component in the QUIC protocol implementation, specifically testing the behavior of the tls_server_handshaker class and related classes under various scenarios.

classes.name: TestTlsServerHandshaker
classes.description: A mock subclass of TlsServerHandshaker used for testing, with methods to set up proof source handles and override default behaviors.

classes.name: TlsServerHandshakerTestSession
classes.description: A test session class that creates a mock crypto server stream for TLS 1.3 handshake testing.

classes.name: TlsServerHandshakerTest
classes.description: A test fixture class parameterized by handshake parameters, setting up server and client sessions, and running various handshake scenarios.

methods.name: InitializeServerConfig
methods.description: Sets up the server's crypto configuration with a proof source and ticket crypter.

methods.name: InitializeServerConfigWithFailingProofSource
methods.description: Sets up the server's crypto configuration with a proof source that fails, for testing failure scenarios.

methods.name: CreateTlsServerHandshakerTestSession
methods.description: Creates and initializes a test server session with a mock TLS handshaker.

methods.name: InitializeServerWithFakeProofSourceHandle
methods.description: Prepares the server session with a fake proof source handle for testing asynchronous proof source operations.

methods.name: InitializeServer
methods.description: Initializes a standard server session for testing.

methods.name: InitializeFakeClient
methods.description: Sets up a fake client session for testing handshake interactions.

methods.name: CompleteCryptoHandshake
methods.description: Performs handshake message exchanges until handshake completes successfully.

methods.name: AdvanceHandshakeWithFakeClient
methods.description: Performs a single handshake message exchange between client and server.

methods.name: ExpectHandshakeSuccessful
methods.description: Verifies that the handshake has completed successfully and security parameters are established.

methods.name: SetupClientCert
methods.description: Configures the client to send a self-signed certificate during handshake.

methods.name: GetTestParams
methods.description: Constructs test parameter permutations for different QUIC versions and resumption settings.

methods.name: PrintToString
methods.description: Converts test parameters to string for test naming.
